SELECT b.ID AS id, b.TITLE, b.CONTENTS,
-- 조회수 b.VIEW_COUNT,
-- 공지 여부 b.IS_NOTIFICATION,
-- 작성/수정일 b.CREATED_AT, b.UPDATED_AT,
-- 댓글 수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_COMMENT c WHERE c.BOARD_ID = b.ID) AS commentCount,
-- 좋아요 수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE l WHERE l.BOARD_ID = b.ID) AS likeCount,
-- 북마크 수 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_BOOKMARK bm WHERE bm.BOARD_ID = b.ID) AS bookmarkCount,
-- 썸네일 1개 ( SELECT URL FROM BOARD_FILE bf WHERE bf.BOARD_ID = b.ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail,
-- 작성자 정보 u.UUID AS writerUid, u.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, u.PROFILE_URL AS writerProfileImage, u.BIO AS writerBio
FROM BOARD b JOIN USER_INFO u ON b.WRITER_UID = u.UUID
WHERE 1 = 1 AND b.STATUS = 'active'
AND u.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND ( b.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR b.CONTENTS LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND ( u.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR b.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR b.CONTENTS LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BOARD_TAG_MAPPING m JOIN BOARD_TAG t ON m.TAG_ID = t.ID WHERE m.BOARD_ID = b.ID AND t.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY b.IS_NOTIFICATION DESC, -- 공지 먼저 b.ID DESC
